Title: Salesforce Platform Engineer
Location: Remote (US)
Duration: 4+ months
Pay rate: $70/hr - $85/hr on W2

Must have skills: Salesforce Advanced Admin Skills, Salesforce Developer Skills, AI/DevOps/SDLC Understanding
Role Overview
The Environment Management Engineer plays a critical role in the stability, predictability, and maturity of an internal Salesforce environment ecosystem. This engineer will support the end-to-end lifecycle of sandbox provisioning, environment governance, metadata/configuration alignment, CI/CD optimization, and automation that improves the speed and quality of delivery across hundreds of scrum teams.
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable automation to improve sandbox provisioning, refresh processes, and environment lifecycle operations.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and validation frameworks to ensure environment health.
  • Debug, optimize, and enhance complex Apex, Lightning, or integration patterns impacting environment behavior.
  • Contribute to design, build, and evolution of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, CumulusCI, and related tools.
  • Participate in code reviews, develop reusable deployment patterns, and support source-driven development.
  • Build automated tests (unit, integration, smoke, performance) to ensure high-quality deployments and reduced regression risk.
  • Maintain environment runlists, API governance, metadata classification, and security models.
  • Ensure compliance with SOX, change management, data retention, and environment access controls.
  • Document and maintain platform policies, architecture artifacts, runbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Support incident resolution, root cause analysis, and preventive engineering to strengthen platform reliability.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, maintain sprint commitments, and proactively identify improvements for the environment ecosystem.
Required Qualifications
  • 4–6 years of platform engineering or development experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, Flows, process automation, and configuration.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, CumulusCI, SonarQube, Sauce Labs).
  • Experience supporting or integrating with MuleSoft via Anypoint Studio (MuleSoft certifications preferred).
  • Deep understanding of metadata management, deployment strategies, profiles, permission sets, and API governance.
  • Solid knowledge of audit/compliance frameworks (SOX), data integrity policies, and secure development practices.
  • Experience supporting multi-scrum, multi-org enterprise implementations.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced Agile/Scrum teams with strong prioritization and project execution skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Required Certifications
  • Salesforce Administrator
  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder
 
Preferred Certifications
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • MuleSoft Certifications (Developer / Integration Architect)

title: Senior High Speed Mixed-Signal I/O & Analog Layout Engineer
description:
LeadStack Inc. is an award-winning, one of the nation's fastest-growing, certified minority-owned (MBE) staffing services provider of contingent workforce. As a recognized industry leader in contingent workforce solutions and Certified as a Great Place to Work, we're proud to partner with some of the most admired Fortune 500 brands in the world.

Job Title: Senior High Speed Mixed-Signal I/O & Analog Layout Engineer
Duration: 12+ Months
Location: San Jose, CA – Onsite
  
Pay range : $100.00 - $110.00/hr on w2
 
Position Details
Description
As a senior high speed mixed-signal layout/analog layout engineer, you will be working with circuit designers located in San Jose, California, USA to accomplish layout tasks. Circuits that you will need to work on includes High Speed RX (receiver), TX (transmitters), PLL, CDR, Analog reference circuits, and so on. You should have experiences doing layout with sub-micron CMOS technologies,
 
Responsibilities:
·         Working with remote circuit designers to determine the chip floorplan. You need to come up with strategies to optimize the parasites, reduce area, and improve High Speed SERDES/analog performance.
·         You need to be able to estimate schedule and come up with plan how to get things done within a dedicated time frame.
·         You should be able to read the design document provided by the foundry and figure out how to resolve issues like latch-up and DRC.
·         Perform custom layout using Virtuoso, and be able to get LVS/DRC clean.
·         You should be familiar with CAD tools, including Virtuoso, Calibre LVS, DRC, SkillCad and so on.
·         Desired to have experience on chip level design, like bump, pad, and ESD strategies.
·         Good communication skills to discuss with circuit designer.
 
Requirements
·         Bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering and 5+ years of professional experience as an IC layout designer; OR 8+ years of professional experience with integrated circuit layout design in lieu of a degree 
 
Preferred Skills:
·         Strong High Speed SERDES/analog layout skills
·         Experience in advanced nodes in IC layout, including finfet 14nm, 8nm, 4nm and 2nm GAA. 
·         Experience in IC layouts with frequencies up to 224Gb/s. 
·         Experience in critical IC layouts, including VCO, clocking circuit, TX, and RX and so on. 
·         Working knowledge in Linux 
·         Proficiency in CAD tools including Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre LVS, DRC, and SkillCad. 
·         Excellency in communications skills in the form of verbal, email, and in documentations. 
·         Be able to work independently.
·         Good to have experience to lead a small team and tape-out an analog IC.

description:

Job Title: SAP Finance Consultant
Duration: 5 Months
Location: Culver City, CA

Pay Range: $100/hr - $120/hr on W2

Senior SAP S/4 Finance Knowledge Transfer Consultant

Job Description:
Role Purpose
  • We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP S/4 Finance Consultant to undertake a focused knowledge transfer assignment supporting the transition of a highly experienced employee approaching retirement.
  • The successful candidate will work side-by-side with the existing subject matter expert, observing, questioning, validating and documenting all operational activities performed across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual cycles. The primary deliverable is a comprehensive, structured knowledge document that enables the organization to retain critical operational knowledge and significantly reduce key-person dependency.
  • This is not a traditional SAP support position. Success will be measured by the quality, completeness and usability of the documentation produced, rather than by project delivery or ticket resolution. This will be evaluated via the hiring manager weekly check ins.
Primary Responsibilities
Knowledge Capture & Documentation
  • Shadow the existing Finance SME throughout all operational activities.
  • Observe and document daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual business processes.
  • Lead structured interviews and technical question-and-answer sessions to uncover undocumented knowledge, business rules and operational rationale.
  • Challenge assumptions and ensure undocumented processes are fully understood before documenting them.
  • Distinguish between system functionality, business process, local practice and individual working methods.
  • Produce documentation that can be understood and consumed by another experienced SAP Finance professional with minimal additional guidance.
SAP S/4 Finance Expertise
Provide sufficient SAP expertise to independently understand and document:
  • Financial Accounting (FI)
  • General Ledger
  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Asset Accounting
  • Bank Accounting
  • Financial Close
  • Foreign Exchange (FOREX) processing
  • Global Tax processes
  • Legal and Statutory Reporting
  • Financial Reporting
  • SAP configuration impacts on business processes
  • Integration points with adjacent business functions
The consultant is expected to use their SAP expertise to ask insightful questions, identify missing information and validate process accuracy rather than simply record observed activities.

Potential Documentation Deliverables

Produce a structured knowledge document including:
  • Process flow diagrams, where needed
  • Month-end, quarter-end and year-end procedures
  • Tax and statutory reporting processes
  • FOREX operational procedures
  • Exception handling guidance
  • Business rules and assumptions
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • Known issues and workarounds
  • Business continuity documentation, where needed but especially if IT doing business work
Documentation should clearly explain:
  • What is performed
  • Why it is performed
  • When it is performed
  • Who performs it
  • System dependencies
  • Risks
  • Key controls
Required Experience
  • Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance experience gained through implementation and production support.
  • Deep knowledge of SAP Financial Accounting and associated business processes.
  • Strong understanding of Global Tax, Legal and Statutory Reporting.
  • Experience supporting Foreign Exchange (FOREX) accounting and processing.
  • Proven experience documenting complex business and system processes.
  • Ability to quickly establish credibility with experienced business subject matter experts.
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Desirable
  • Experience within the Media & Entertainment industry.
  • Experience participating in SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes.
Personal Attributes
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  • Exceptional patience and professionalism.
  • Strong listening and interviewing skills.
  • Natural curiosity and a willingness to challenge assumptions.
  • Excellent analytical thinking.
  • Ability to build trust with experienced stakeholders.
  • Highly structured and methodical working practices.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • The confidence to ask probing questions until complete understanding is achieved.
